gen-gf-sniglet-gf-host-grotesk: Distinctive from the first glance, Sniglet draws pencil-like lines that never thicken or thin. Host Grotesk, a plain sans, sweeps its curves open and keeps the page feeling current and unfussy.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-hubot-sans: Chunky, friendly, and hard to miss: Sniglet keeps one constant pen width from letter to letter. Hubot Sans, a modern sans, opens its e wide.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-ibm-plex-sans-arabic: IBM Plex Sans Arabic reads clean and approachable, with open apertures that make each letter easy to catch. Sniglet brings a plain, unshaded line and some swagger, and the sans-serif body settles beside it like a friendly counterweight.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-ibm-plex-sans-devanaga: IBM Plex Sans Devanagari has rope-loose curves that never knot at the ends, giving it a modern, easygoing feel. And Sniglet, with its flat, unvarying line weight in every letter, supplies the display punch above that plain sans.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-ibm-plex-sans-hebrew: IBM Plex Sans Hebrew reads contemporary and approachable, its s and c left open and uncrowded throughout. Sniglet's single-depth cut sits above it comfortably.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-ibm-plex-sans-jp: Professional but friendly, IBM Plex Sans JP ends each curve in a clean, open gap. Sniglet's pipe-cleaner strokes make the heading feel distinctive, and that plain sans keeps everything underneath steady and approachable.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-ibm-plex-sans-kr: Modern in outlook, IBM Plex Sans KR stays open at every curve end, while Sniglet shows no calligraphic swell on any downstroke. Paragraphs in that plain sans should flow smoothly.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-ibm-plex-sans-thai: Sniglet holds a steady pen pressure from its first letter to its last, with terminals that stop short of curling. And IBM Plex Sans Thai, a contemporary sans-serif, points the two ends of its c apart like open pincers.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-ibm-plex-sans-thai-loo: Round and unthinning, Sniglet builds bowls with no thinning at the sides. And IBM Plex Sans Thai Looped, a clean sans, would quickly lose its quiet curves if set large.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-imprima: Approachable and soft, Imprima gives each line a smooth, tube-like look with flared terminals. Sniglet is the one to grab attention with its distinctive, commanding display shapes, while the sans quietly does the explaining.
